# Stephanie Milani

> Incoming Assistant Professor in the Computer Science Department at Johns Hopkins University (starting 2027) and incoming postdoctoral researcher at Microsoft Research NY. PhD in Machine Learning from Carnegie Mellon University, advised by Fei Fang.

Stephanie Milani builds practical AI agents that learn from feedback to complement and augment human abilities, designing techniques for reinforcement learning, foundation models, and human-centered AI. She previously spent a year as an Assistant Professor / Faculty Fellow at NYU Courant, working with Rajesh Ranganath and Sumit Chopra. She is a Rising Star in ML & Systems, a Future Leader in Responsible Data Science & AI, and a Rising Star in Data Science. Her dissertation received Honorable Mention for the SCS Dissertation Award at CMU. She is also a Newman Civic Fellow and received the CMU Machine Learning Department Teaching Assistant Award.
